item.title: Review: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is superb, streamlined and safe
item.description: Nintendo's new Ocarina of Time remake enshrines its place in the gaming canon for generations to come. But despite its stupendous production values, the game left me feeling oddly bereft.
item.content:encoded:

item.description: Lifting wallets was part of Turturro's training for the film The Only Living Pickpocket in New York. In it, he plays a small-time thief who's also the primary caretaker for his ailing wife.

item.title: After last year's storm, this remote Alaska town is still picking up the pieces
item.description: In October 2025, the remnants of a typhoon seriously damaged Alaska Native villages in the far western part of the state. A year later, one of the hardest hit communities is still recovering.
